beats.say: Hi! A browser extension is a small program. It can see and change the pages you open.
The widest permission is this one: read and change all your data on all websites.

label.text: Read and change all your data on all websites

beats.say: An extension can be honest today and turn into a spy tomorrow with one update.
Install only what you need, only from the official store. On a work computer, only what technical support approves.

scenes.prompt: Would you install this extension or decline it?

label.text: Read and change all your data on all websites

cards.explain: A free VPN extension sees all your traffic and often earns its money from your data. For work, use only the VPN your office provides.

label.text: Show the weather forecast for Baku
Read and change all your data on all websites
Read data you copy and paste

cards.explain: A weather forecast does not need your pages or what you copy. If the permission is bigger than the job, decline.

label.text: See only the open page when you press the button
Save images to the Downloads folder

cards.explain: The permissions fit the job and only work when you press the button. An extension like this adds no real risk.
An extension from outside the store has passed no checks at all. Install extensions only from the browser's official store.

label.text: Store your notes in this browser

cards.explain: The extension does not touch your sites and keeps notes only in the browser's own storage. The risk is low.

question.prompt: An extension you needed only once is still in your browser. What do you do?

options.label: I remove it and reinstall it if I ever need it
options.feedback: Right. An extension you do not use gives you nothing, but its risk stays.

options.label: I just turn it off
options.feedback: Turning it off helps, but a forgotten extension comes back with one click. If you do not need it, remove it.

options.label: I keep it, maybe I will need it some day
options.feedback: The extension can change owners, and an update can turn it into a spy. Do not keep what you do not need.

scenes.explain: Every extension is a door into your pages. Fewer extensions means less risk.

scenes.title: Extension store
scenes.intro: You want an extension that shows exchange rates quickly. Pick what to do at each step.

steps.label: Mezenne Pro: free download
steps.say: The first page in the search looks like the store.

actions.label: Download the extension
actions.feedback: This is not the official store but a copy of it. Anything from here has passed no checks.

actions.label: Check the address
actions.feedback: This domain is not the store's own address. Open the store from the browser menu.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. Install extensions only from the browser's own store.

steps.label: Mezenne Pro: 4.1 stars, 80 thousand users
steps.say: Now you are in the official store. Before installing, the browser will show the permissions.

actions.label: Add to browser
actions.feedback: The official store is a good start. Now read the permissions carefully.

actions.label: Not needed
actions.feedback: That is a good choice too. You can see the rates on your bank's site.

label.text: Read and change all your data on all websites
See your tabs and browsing history

steps.say: Does showing exchange rates need these permissions?

actions.label: Add extension
actions.feedback: Exchange rates need neither all websites nor your history. A permission this wide opens the way to spying.

actions.label: Decline
actions.feedback: Right. If the permission does not fit the job, do not install it.

steps.label: Installed extensions: 7, unused in the last six months: 4
steps.say: Your browser also has old extensions. What do you do with them?

actions.label: Remove the four unused extensions
actions.feedback: Excellent. Each removed extension closes one door into your pages.

actions.label: Keep them all
actions.feedback: Unused extensions still update and can still see your pages. Remove what you do not need.

title.text: Hava Bu Gün was turned off

body.text: Malware was found in this extension.
It has also been removed from the store.

steps.say: The browser turned one of the extensions off by itself.

actions.label: Remove it and tell technical support
actions.feedback: Right. Technical support will check what the extension collected and help you change passwords.

actions.label: Turn back on
actions.feedback: The browser did not turn it off for nothing. Turned back on, the extension keeps collecting data.

points: Install an extension only when you need it, and only from the official store
Be careful with any extension that wants data on all websites
Remove the extensions you do not use
